meaning: A place where you buy things.
example: The shop near my house opens at seven.
exampleTamil: என் வீட்டின் அருகில் உள்ள கடை ஏழு மணிக்கு திறக்கும்.

meaning: Costing less money than something else.
example: This shop is cheaper than that one.
exampleTamil: இந்தக் கடை அந்தக் கடையை விட விலை குறைவு.

meaning: The person who takes your money at a shop.
example: The cashier gave me the bill.

meaning: A container you carry to put things in.
example: She put the tomatoes in a basket.

meaning: A soft container to carry things you buy.
example: Please bring your own bag to the market.
exampleTamil: தயவுசெய்து சந்தைக்கு உங்கள் சொந்த பையை கொண்டு வாருங்கள்.

meaning: The price of something per unit or amount.
example: What is the rate of tomatoes today?

meaning: Paper or plastic that covers a product.
example: Throw the wrapper in the dustbin.

meaning: A small paper or code that gives you a discount.
example: I have a coupon for ten percent off.
exampleTamil: என்னிடம் பத்து சதவீத தள்ளுபடிக்கான கூப்பன் உள்ளது.

meaning: To get something by paying money.
example: I want to buy a new bag.
exampleTamil: நான் ஒரு புதிய பை வாங்க விரும்புகிறேன்.

meaning: To give something to a person for money.
example: They sell fresh fruit here.

meaning: How big or small something is.
example: Do you have this shirt in a bigger size?
exampleTamil: இந்தச் சட்டை பெரிய அளவில் உங்களிடம் இருக்கிறதா?

meaning: A piece of clothing that women or girls wear.
example: She bought a red dress for the party.
exampleTamil: அவள் விருந்துக்காக ஒரு சிவப்பு ஆடை வாங்கினாள்.

meaning: Things you wear on your feet to walk outside.
example: My shoes are too tight.

meaning: Plants like carrots and beans that we eat.
example: I buy vegetables every morning.

meaning: Having lines of different colours.
example: He bought a striped shirt for work.
exampleTamil: அவன் வேலைக்காக ஒரு கோடு போட்ட சட்டை வாங்கினான்.

meaning: How much or how many of something.
example: Please tell me the quantity you need.

meaning: The name of a company that makes a product.
example: Which brand of soap do you use?

meaning: New and not old or stale.
example: These vegetables are very fresh.

meaning: Strong blue trousers made of denim.
example: He wears jeans to college.

meaning: Soft things you wear on your feet inside shoes.
example: I need a new pair of socks.
exampleTamil: எனக்கு ஒரு புதிய ஜோடி காலுறை வேண்டும்.

meaning: A small bag for money, mostly used by women.
example: She took money out of her purse.

meaning: The full amount after adding everything.
example: What is the total for these items?

meaning: Simple, with no pattern or design.
example: I like plain shirts without any print.
exampleTamil: எனக்கு டிசைன் இல்லாத எளிய சட்டைகள் பிடிக்கும்.

meaning: A white drink we get from cows.
example: I buy milk from the shop every day.

meaning: Small white grains we cook and eat.
example: We need two kilos of rice.
